Private shared-memory txncache structs, constants, and pool/map/list helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the private shared-memory layout and helper limits for the transaction cache used by the runtime. It declares the per-transaction, per-page, and per-blockcache data structures, including fields for fork links, blockhash data, transaction hash truncation, and page accounting. It also sets up pool, map, list, and set containers through template includes so the cache can manage blockcache entries and root fork chains. The `fd_txncache_shmem_private` structure stores the global cache state, the read-write lock, size limits, free page count, root list, and a magic value for validation.
